scenes.narration: GlobePin puts every place you have been on one map, with the flights between them.
Tap plus and enter two airports; the route, distance and duration are added for you.
Spin the same history on a 3D globe.
Countries visited, continents covered and every trip, counted for you.
Set a goal for where you are going next and watch the gap close.
Free on the App Store for iPhone and iPad. It syncs over your own iCloud account; nothing to sign up for.

bumper.note: Purplelink LLC brand bumper at start and end; narration never overlaps the bumpers.
